name: claude-plugins-official
tagline_zh: 别再翻 GitHub 大海捞针，Anthropic 亲自筛选的 Claude 插件目录，每个都经过验证。
tagline_en: Skip the GitHub rabbit hole. Anthropic-vetted Claude plugins, ready to install, no more trial-and-error afternoons.
desc_en: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
why_zh: 同类插件合集多是个人整理，这个由 Anthropic 官方维护，质量有保底，且持续更新，不会装到半成品。
why_en: Unlike community lists, this is Anthropic's own curated directory, ensuring quality and freshness—no half-baked plugins.
